title: Users can't log in
description: Login requests started failing with HTTP 500 shortly after the service started.

groundTruth.cause: The Redis connection pool was exhausted (100/100 connections), so session lookups first timed out and then were refused, which made authentication requests fail with HTTP 500.
goodNextSteps: Check Redis client connection counts and pool configuration (max size, leaks from connections not being released)
Check Redis server health and maxclients

notes: Synthetic sanity-check case built from the hand-test fixtures.
